mission-control.label: Active scenarios
mission-control.description: Count of scenarios currently running with green health checks.

mission-control.label: Scenario health summary
mission-control.description: Rollup of scenario health states across the local Vrooli instance.

mission-control.label: Swarm throughput (last 24h)
mission-control.description: Completed backlog items produced by the swarm in the trailing day.

mission-control.label: Active agents
mission-control.description: Number of agents with at least one run executed in the last hour.

mission-control.label: System uptime
mission-control.description: Wall-clock uptime for the local Vrooli host.

mission-control.label: Monthly recurring revenue
mission-control.description: Rolling MRR computed from Stripe subscriptions.
mission-control.whatIsNeeded: LPBS /api/v1/admin/dashboard/revenue endpoint must be implemented by the lpbs-command-center-dashboard-endpoints execute item.

mission-control.label: Revenue today
mission-control.description: Sum of successful checkout_sessions in the current day.
mission-control.whatIsNeeded: LPBS /api/v1/admin/dashboard/revenue endpoint with a daily-rollup query.

hive.label: Total scenarios
hive.description: Count of scenarios registered with the Vrooli scenario registry.

hive.label: Completeness score distribution
hive.description: Distribution of 0-100 completeness scores bucketed by classification.

hive.label: Per-scenario health
hive.description: Per-scenario health badges (green/yellow/red) derived from lifecycle checks.

hive.label: Allocated ports
hive.description: Current port allocations per scenario, reported by the lifecycle manager.

hive.label: Usage frequency (last 7 days)
hive.description: How often each scenario is opened or invoked.
hive.whatIsNeeded: Usage tracking is not yet collected anywhere. Needs either client instrumentation posting to an analytics endpoint or lifecycle-manager invocation counters.

forge.label: Backlog throughput
forge.description: Items completed per hour, day, week; Swarm Manager stats engine.

forge.label: Timing statistics
forge.description: Median, p90, p99 run durations across phases (research, workshop, execute).

forge.label: Scope footprint
forge.description: Scope-path breadth across concurrent runs; contention hotspots.

forge.label: Blocking items
forge.description: Items currently blocked on review, dependency, or scope lock.

forge.label: Per-agent utilisation
forge.description: Runs per agent profile and success-rate rollup.

forge.label: Review queue
forge.description: Awaiting-approval runs and mean time to human review.

ledger.label: Subscribers by tier
ledger.description: Count of active subscriptions bucketed by plan_tier (free/solo/pro/studio/business).

ledger.label: Churn (last 30 days)
ledger.description: Count of subscriptions with canceled_at inside the 30-day window.

ledger.label: Credit balances
ledger.description: Distribution of credit_wallets balances across users.
ledger.whatIsNeeded: Histogram aggregation endpoint; raw credit_wallets rows available but not aggregated yet.

ledger.label: Credit consumption rate
ledger.description: Credits burned per day derived from credit_transactions.
ledger.whatIsNeeded: Pre-aggregated daily-burn endpoint; underlying table is available.

ledger.label: Per-limit-key usage
ledger.description: usage_records summarised per limit_key per billing period.
ledger.whatIsNeeded: Aggregation endpoint; raw usage_records exist but need grouping.

broadcast.label: CTA click-through
broadcast.description: CTA clicks summarised from metrics_events variant traffic.

broadcast.label: A/B variant lift
broadcast.description: Per-variant comparison rolled up from metrics_events.

broadcast.label: Social reach
broadcast.whatIsNeeded: Social-platform API integrations (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube) are not wired in yet.

broadcast.label: SEO rankings
broadcast.whatIsNeeded: SEO-data integration (e.g. Ahrefs, GSC export) not yet built.

broadcast.label: Campaign performance
broadcast.description: Paid and email-campaign metrics (spend, CTR, cost per conversion).
broadcast.whatIsNeeded: Campaign-platform ingestion (Ads, Mailchimp, etc.) is not yet in place.

panorama.label: Composite system health
panorama.description: System-wide health summary composed from Mission Control + The Hive.
panorama.whatIsNeeded: Panorama depends on downstream dashboards — partial until all inputs are live (notably revenue on Mission Control).

panorama.label: Composite throughput
panorama.description: Cross-dashboard throughput view sourced from The Forge.

panorama.label: Composite revenue
panorama.description: Top-line revenue indicator rolled up from Ledger.
panorama.whatIsNeeded: Depends on LPBS admin-dashboard endpoints (revenue, subscriptions, churn).

panorama.label: Composite reach
panorama.description: Cross-channel audience view composed from Broadcast.
panorama.whatIsNeeded: Broadcast partial coverage (social/SEO/campaign gaps) keeps this partial.

panorama.label: Composite portfolio
panorama.description: Scenario portfolio view rolled up from The Hive.
